ticker: Bahrain reports industrial site hit amid regional strikes
Mexico captures top drug lord El Chapo Isidro
India smashes highest-ever Test total in New Zealand
Delhi air quality hits hazardous levels at 386
CrowdStrike in talks to acquire cybersecurity firm Zscaler

articles.headline: Bahrain reports industrial hit as regional tensions escalate
articles.brief: Bahrain confirms an Iranian attack struck an industrial facility as air defences intercepted incoming threats. Meanwhile, discussions regarding the Strait of Hormuz remain deadlocked as foreign ministers debate terms for reopening regional shipping lanes.

articles.headline: Mexico captures top drug lord El Chapo Isidro
articles.brief: Mexican authorities have captured high-profile drug lord 'El Chapo Isidro,' triggering a wave of deadly cartel violence and unrest across Sinaloa. The 44-year-old international fugitive had a multi-million dollar bounty on his head.

articles.headline: CrowdStrike in talks to acquire security firm Zscaler
articles.brief: Cybersecurity giant CrowdStrike is reportedly in advanced discussions to acquire rival firm Zscaler. If completed, the multi-billion-dollar deal would significantly reshape the enterprise cloud security and threat-detection landscape.

articles.headline: Amazon CEO defends AI data centres against local opposition
articles.brief: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy warned that scaling back investments in AI data infrastructure would be a historic mistake that allows global competitors to dictate tech standards. The remarks come amid growing regulatory and community pushback.

articles.headline: India posts record 720 runs against New Zealand in Test
articles.brief: Shubman Gill's Indian cricket team established a historic milestone by scoring 720 runs, registering the highest-ever Test total in New Zealand. Centuries from key batsmen anchored the record-breaking innings in Wellington.

articles.headline: Delhi air quality plunges into hazardous category at 386
articles.brief: Delhi's Air Quality Index reached a hazardous 386 on Sunday morning, aggravated by a thick smoky haze across the national capital. The city recorded the highest pollution levels among Indian metropolitan areas.

articles.headline: SoftBank founder explored massive SK Hynix buyout
articles.brief: SoftBank Group founder Masayoshi Son reportedly explored an ambitious $1 trillion buyout of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix. The exploratory move highlights aggressive consolidation strategies within the global semiconductor sector.

articles.headline: Russian cargo ship targeted by drone strike in Baltic Sea
articles.brief: A Russian cargo vessel caught fire in the Baltic Sea following a reported drone strike, prompting the crew to safely evacuate. Naval authorities are monitoring the environmental and navigational fallout from the attack.

articles.headline: South Korea Education Minister resigns over AI exam cheating
articles.brief: South Korea's Education Minister has tendered resignation following a massive nationwide security breach involving AI-assisted exam cheating. A top candidate confessed to using hidden miniature technology to secure a near-perfect score.

articles.headline: India corporate earnings outlook remains upbeat for H2
articles.brief: Indian corporations project robust financial performance for the second half of fiscal year 2027, driven by broad-based domestic demand and stable input costs. Analysts expect resilient growth across multiple consumer and industrial sectors.

articles.headline: Maharashtra FDA cancels multiple food business licences
articles.brief: Maharashtra's Food and Drug Administration has cancelled 38 establishment licences, including major delivery platforms, following a sweeping statewide crackdown on adulterated goods and regulatory non-compliance.

articles.headline: India's Congress warns of fresh protests against Meta
articles.brief: India's opposition Congress party has threatened renewed nationwide protests against Meta following contentious street clashes between party demonstrators and police forces outside corporate offices.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh wins national acclaim for HIV control success
articles.brief: Andhra Pradesh has received top national recognition for outstanding progress in its public health HIV/AIDS control programs. Multiple districts successfully achieved benchmark targets set by international health monitoring bodies.

articles.headline: Rishabh Pant delivers stellar century in Wellington Test
articles.brief: Wicketkeeper-batsman Rishabh Pant countered intense scrutiny with an aggressive, masterful century against New Zealand. His resilient innings stabilized India's record-setting total and reaffirmed his vital role in the national squad.
